- Preferred PO numbering / prefix you need on invoices (we can add on our end, but want to match Redwood's PO format).
- Whether Redwood can set per-line spend ceilings for split deliverables (we have two SKUs in the SOW that should be capped independently).
- Invoicing cadence: monthly vs milestone; and the remit-to address for AP.

Also attaching a brief billing contact list: accounts@silverpine.com. If you need a corporate contact or vendor code, let me know.

Hi Lena — thanks for the docs and the SOW. We're ready to proceed on our side. A couple quick notes so procurement issues the PO with the right serialization and line controls:

1) PO numbering: our accounting system expects a Redwood PO number with this pattern: RINF-{ACCOUNTCODE}-{SEQ}. For external vendors we add the RINF prefix; procurement will assign ACCOUNTCODE once vendor is created (usually a 4-char code). Example: RINF-SPNE-000123. If you can put "PO number: TBD" on invoices until we assign it, that's fine.

2) Line-level spend ceilings: Redwood supports both PO-level and per-line caps. We can enforce a firm cap on an individual SKU (useful for the two deliverables you referenced). To do that we need the line-item names and unit prices exactly as they appear on your invoice. Can you provide a line breakdown CSV? If you prefer, send a draft invoice with line items and indicate which lines need independent caps.

3) Remit-to and invoicing cadence: we prefer monthly invoicing for subscription components and milestone invoicing for professional services. Please confirm which applies to each SOW line. Our AP remit-to address will be provided after vendor activation; in the meantime put accounts@silverpine.com on invoices so we can match them.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form filled with minimum fields; please complete the banking section and return (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). I'll loop in procurement for PO issuance once we get the line-level CSV and the completed form.

Next steps I will: create the vendor record and kick off a provisional PO (serial TBD) — procurement will then finalize the serial and cap settings.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@silverpine.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Silverpine details for PO and spend caps

Thanks Priya / Lena — quick operational note from procurement & AP so everyone's aligned: 

- PO assignment flow: procurement will create a provisional PO record in the system ("P-XXX") while vendor onboarding is finalized. Once the vendor code is assigned (ACCOUNTCODE) we atomically re-serialize the PO to the production format: RINF-{ACCOUNTCODE}-{SEQ}. The provisional number will still be visible on early invoices but we ask vendors to switch to the final serial after confirmation.

- Spend enforcement: we support hard caps (invoice rejected when amount > cap) and soft caps (warnings only). For Silverpine initial setup we recommend hard caps at line level for the two deliverables you flagged, and a soft cap at the PO total for flexibility. Specify which you prefer per-line in the CSV.

- Multiple billing entities / split invoices: if you need to route part of the SOW to a different remit or cost center, indicate the split % per line; we will create separate PO lines with independent caps. Note that each distinct remit will require a separate vendor remit record in our AP system.

I've attached a sample PO mapping CSV (sample_po_mapping.csv) with column headers we require: sku, description, unit_price, quantity, preferred_cap, cap_type (hard/soft), remit_email, cost_center. Please populate and return.

If you want, we can provisionally set the two SKU lines as follows to expedite:
- SKU-SPNE-CORE: cap $45,000 (hard)
- SKU-SPNE-INTG: cap $12,000 (hard)

Priya — once we have the completed CSV and vendor_bank details from the onboarding form I'll trigger the final PO serial assignment.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Aditya — thanks for the clear guidance. We're returning:
- Completed onboarding form (banking section filled) — see attached.
- Draft invoice with line items and suggested caps (CSV exported from our billing system).

Confirming the two SKUs should be capped independently. We prefer the hard cap on both SKUs as you suggested. For the PO total, a soft cap works for now.

One question: our professional services line (SKU-SPNE-INTG) is often billed as time & materials; if a hard cap is applied, can we submit a time log as backup on each invoice for claims over $5k? That will help avoid disputes while keeping the cap in place.

If Redwood requires separate remit entities for split billing, we'll provide the secondary remit contact and legal name in the onboarding form and include a note in the invoice CSV.

I'll upload the signed onboarding form and the CSV to the DocuSign/HubSpot links you provided after I finish a quick internal approval. Expect those within 24 hours.
